comment: The audio input is the only jack the maker left unnamed, so it shows no tooltip; the panel letters it I. The panel prints CUT, RES, FBK, GAIN and a radiation symbol for the five main knobs, HP and LP for the two outputs, and plus and minus for the two modulation jacks. The five attenuverters use their sign to choose an input rather than to invert: src/Loam.cpp:131-150 multiplies by the positive jack only when the knob is above centre and by the negative jack only when it is below. The frequency modulation is applied in octaves, while resonance, feedback, gain and radioactivity modulation are divided by ten first. Bypassing the module passes the audio input to the lowpass output.
